description: Defines the public interface and classes for a disk cache system used in network stack, including backend creation, cache entries, and file operations.

classes.name: Backend
classes.description: Interface for disk cache backend, managing cache entries and statistics.

classes.name: Entry
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with methods for reading, writing, and managing cache data.

classes.name: EntryResult
classes.description: Result of cache entry operations, owning a cache entry or error status.

classes.name: RangeResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a range availability query within a cache entry.

classes.name: BackendFileOperations
classes.description: Interface for file operations in a sandboxed environment.

classes.name: UnboundBackendFileOperations
classes.description: Backend file operations not yet bound to a sequence.

classes.name: TrivialFileOperations
classes.description: Simple implementation of BackendFileOperations using base functions.

methods.name: CreateCacheBackend
methods.description: Creates a cache backend instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadForTesting
methods.description: Flushes internal cache threads synchronously for testing.

methods.name: FlushCacheThreadAsynchronouslyForTesting
methods.description: Asynchronously flushes internal cache threads for testing.
